name: Eurocodes with the German National Annexes (DIN EN NA)
edition: DIN EN 1990-1998 with the National Annexes (NA)
description: The Eurocodes with the German National Annexes (alpha 9 track C15): only the Nationally Determined Parameters, everything else from the base pack Eurocodes. DIN EN 1990/NA Eq 6.10 with the recommended γ and ψ; DIN EN 1991-1-1/NA imposed loads of Table 6.1DE; DIN EN 1991-1-4/NA wind zones 1-4 (vb,0 22.5-30 m/s) by town with the velocity pressure profiles of Annex NA.B (inland, coast, North Sea islands) and the simplified pressures up to 25 m; DIN EN 1991-1-3/NA snow zones 1, 1a, 2, 2a, 3 by altitude; DIN EN 1992-1-1/NA αcc 0.85, CRd,c 0.15/γc, ν1 = 0.75 ν2; DIN EN 1993-1-1/NA γM0 1.0, γM1 1.1, γM2 1.25; DIN EN 1997-1/NA with DIN 1054 design approach 2*; DIN EN 1998-1/NA seismic zones 0-3 with agR and the combined subsoil classes. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md for checking against the printed annexes.
